definition: being a member of a group
description: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.
transcript: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?

taps.target: the woman in the white hoodie
the man in the checked shirt
